Definition: properly, pallor, i.e. hence, the yellowish green of young and sickly vegetation; concretely, verdure, i.e. grass or vegetation
BiblicalUsage: The word yereq carries the sense of green herbs, verdure. In Genesis 1:30, I have given every green herb for meat, and it appears again in Exodus 10:15.
TheologicalSignificance: Every green herb was given for food, and I hold that yereq is God's provision written into the first chapter.
